payload.description_html: Comparative material from near Onefour, Alberta. (A) Cryptarcus (“Chasmosaurus”) russelli referred partial parietal (TMP 2013.019.0038) in dorsal view; (B) same in ventral view; (C) left postorbital horncore (CMNFV 55193) in lateral view, possibly referable to Cr. russelli; (D) same in medial view.
